case_title: SARABJEET SINGH MOKHA v. THE DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JABALPUR & ORS.
neutral_facts: The case involves an individual who was detained under the National Security Act, 1980. The detention order was initially passed on May 11, 2021, and the individual was detained on May 12, 2021. The order was approved by the State Government on May 13, 2021. The individual submitted a representation against the detention order on May 18, 2021, which was communicated to the State Government and Central Government on May 20, 2021. The Central Government received the representation on June 1, 2021, and the State Government received it on May 24, 2021. The Central Government rejected the representation on June 24, 2021, and the State Government rejected it on July 15, 2021. The individual was not informed of the rejection of the representation until it was communicated to him on June 28, 2021. The Supreme Court held that the delay in considering the representation and the failure to communicate the rejection of the representation violated the individual's constitutional rights under Article 22(5) of the Constitution. The order of detention was therefore invalidated.
